description: Authoritative canonical registry of mathematical, temporal, and domain symbols for SRS formalization.

symbols.definition: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) Globally / Always operator: property must hold in all states along the execution path.
symbols.notes: Unary temporal operator. Dual of F (Finally).

symbols.definition: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) Finally / Eventually operator: property must hold at some state along the execution path.
symbols.notes: Unary temporal operator. Dual of G (Globally).

symbols.definition: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) Next operator: property must hold at the immediate subsequent state.
symbols.notes: Unary temporal operator referring to next discrete time step.

symbols.definition: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) Strong Until operator: left operand must hold continuously until right operand becomes true, which must eventually occur.
Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) Release operator: right operand holds until and including the point where left operand becomes true, or holds forever if left never becomes true.
symbols.notes: Binary temporal operator. Dual of Until.

symbols.definition: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) Weak Until operator: left operand holds until right operand becomes true, or holds forever if right operand never occurs.
Logical implication connective: antecedent implies consequent.
symbols.notes: Evaluates to true unless antecedent is true and consequent is false.

symbols.definition: Logical conjunction connective: true if and only if both operands are true.
Logical disjunction connective: true if at least one operand is true.
Logical negation operator: inverts the truth value of the operand.
Logical equivalence connective: true if both operands have identical truth values.
Condition predicate indicating complete loss of communication has occurred across redundant buses.
symbols.notes: Triggers immediate output disabling sequence in Safety Subsystem.

symbols.definition: State predicate asserting that all system actuator and signal outputs are disabled into safe state.
symbols.notes: Target state achieved upon safety trigger.

symbols.definition: Concrete timing upper bound constant: 10 milliseconds deadline for output shutdown.
symbols.notes: Metric deadline parameter for temporal operator F[0, 10ms].
